title: 我的一天

content.cn: 早上七点，我起床。
content.pinyin: Zǎo shang qī diǎn, wǒ qǐ chuáng.
content.en: At seven in the morning, I get up.

content.cn: 我刷牙、洗脸、吃早饭。
content.pinyin: Wǒ shuā yá, xǐ liǎn, chī zǎo fàn.
content.en: I brush my teeth, wash my face, and eat breakfast.

content.cn: 八点，我去学校。我是学生。
content.pinyin: Bā diǎn, wǒ qù xué xiào. Wǒ shì xué sheng.
content.en: At eight o'clock, I go to school. I am a student.

content.cn: 中午十二点，我吃午饭。下午我上课。
content.pinyin: Zhōng wǔ shí èr diǎn, wǒ chī wǔ fàn. Xià wǔ wǒ shàng kè.
content.en: At noon twelve o'clock, I eat lunch. In the afternoon I have classes.

content.cn: 晚上六点，我回家。我做作业，看电视。
content.pinyin: Wǎn shang liù diǎn, wǒ huí jiā. Wǒ zuò zuò yè, kàn diàn shì.
content.en: At six in the evening, I go home. I do homework and watch TV.

content.cn: 十点，我睡觉。这是我的一天。
content.pinyin: Shí diǎn, wǒ shuì jiào. Zhè shì wǒ de yī tiān.
content.en: At ten o'clock, I sleep. This is my day.

excerpt: 了解一个中国学生的日常生活，从早上起床到晚上睡觉。

title: 在餐厅

content.cn: 服务员：您好！请坐。
content.pinyin: Fú wù yuán: Nín hǎo! Qǐng zuò.
content.en: Waiter: Hello! Please sit.

content.cn: 客人：谢谢。我要一杯茶。
content.pinyin: Kè rén: Xiè xie. Wǒ yào yī bēi chá.
content.en: Guest: Thank you. I want a cup of tea.

content.cn: 服务员：好的。您要吃什么？
content.pinyin: Fú wù yuán: Hǎo de. Nín yào chī shén me?
content.en: Waiter: Okay. What would you like to eat?

content.cn: 客人：我要一碗米饭和一个菜。
content.pinyin: Kè rén: Wǒ yào yī wǎn mǐ fàn hé yī gè cài.
content.en: Guest: I want a bowl of rice and a dish.

content.cn: 服务员：好的。请等一下。
content.pinyin: Fú wù yuán: Hǎo de. Qǐng děng yī xià.
content.en: Waiter: Okay. Please wait a moment.

content.cn: （三十分钟后）
content.pinyin: (Sān shí fēn zhōng hòu)
content.en: (Thirty minutes later)

content.cn: 客人：服务员，买单！
content.pinyin: Kè rén: Fú wù yuán, mǎi dān!
content.en: Guest: Waiter, check please!

content.cn: 服务员：一共五十块。
content.pinyin: Fú wù yuán: Yī gòng wǔ shí kuài.
content.en: Waiter: Fifty yuan in total.

excerpt: 学习在餐厅点餐的基本对话和常用词汇。

title: 我的家

content.cn: 我家有四口人：爸爸、妈妈、妹妹和我。
content.pinyin: Wǒ jiā yǒu sì kǒu rén: bà ba, mā ma, mèi mei hé wǒ.
content.en: There are four people in my family: dad, mom, younger sister and me.

content.cn: 爸爸是医生，妈妈是老师。
content.pinyin: Bà ba shì yī shēng, mā ma shì lǎo shī.
content.en: Dad is a doctor, mom is a teacher.

content.cn: 妹妹今年五岁，她很可爱。
content.pinyin: Mèi mei jīn nián wǔ suì, tā hěn kě ài.
content.en: My sister is five years old this year, she is very cute.

content.cn: 我们住在一个大房子里。房子有三个卧室，一个客厅，一个厨房和两个卫生间。
content.pinyin: Wǒ men zhù zài yī gè dà fáng zi lǐ. Fáng zi yǒu sān gè wò shì, yī gè kè tīng, yī gè chú fáng hé liǎng gè wèi shēng jiān.
content.en: We live in a big house. The house has three bedrooms, one living room, one kitchen and two bathrooms.

content.cn: 我的卧室很漂亮。有一张床，一张桌子和一个书架。
content.pinyin: Wǒ de wò shì hěn piào liang. Yǒu yī zhāng chuáng, yī zhāng zhuō zi hé yī gè shū jià.
content.en: My bedroom is very beautiful. There is a bed, a desk and a bookshelf.

content.cn: 我爱我的家！
content.pinyin: Wǒ ài wǒ de jiā!
content.en: I love my home!

excerpt: 介绍家庭成员和房子的结构，学习家庭和房间相关词汇。
